errors.text_span: 整体呈现先上升后下降的趋势
errors.evidence: The description of the trend for the red line as 'first rising then falling' is incorrect. The line first decreases from A1 (0.166) to A2 (0.163), then rises to its peak at B1 (0.175), and subsequently decreases. The initial part of the trend is mischaracterized.
The description identifies the blue line representing the 'random network' as a dashed line ('虚线'), whereas in the figure it is a solid line.
